extension.summary: Curated movie/show widgets for Arctic Fuse, sourced from MDBList or your local library
extension.description: Live-resolves curated lists against your local Kodi library via JSON-RPC and exposes each one as its own independently-addressable widget: exact-ordered lists (Trending Movies, MCU chronological order, Star Wars order, Best Picture Winners), a Trending Shows widget, and date-windowed ones (Christmas, Halloween, Valentine's Day, May the 4th, Star Trek Day, Nick November, Friday the 13th) that return empty outside their window so the skin's auto-hide takes care of showing/hiding them. New lists can be added from the addon's own settings screen (label, type, URL, optional window) without redeploying -- no Jellyfin metadata is touched, no external cron job or file share is required.
